organization: DORA (San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment)

sources.label: DORA (San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment)

title: Interim Progress Report on a “Beyond the Article” Action Group: Learnings and Next Steps
what_changed: DORA published an interim report from the "Beyond the Article" action group (co-led by the International Science Council, HHMI and ASAPbio, six convenings March-October 2026 after a November 2025 Pisa workshop): a mapping of 23 initiatives working to recognise datasets, software, code, protocols and preprints, plus where progress stalls and what barriers remain.
why_it_matters: Research assessment and publishing still revolve around the journal article, while modern research produces many other outputs; the report documents the recognition gap between what research produces and what is evaluated, cited and rewarded.
